description: Mark an AI-prepared human action as a scoped false positive and optionally attach a structured decision report to the IP history. Write action; requires confirmation.

applyToExisting.description: Whether to apply to existing matching IP investigations (closes and unblocks them). Not for the autonomous agent.

conditions.description: Restrictive exclusion conditions on the request (all must match unless matchMode is "any"). The app and rule scope come from the alert and ruleScope, not from a condition. The autonomous agent's exclusion is pinned to this row's IP by the server (client_ip equals), so its conditions can only narrow it.

operator.description: Text operators; in / not_in take comma-separated values.

value.description: A string; comma-separated for in / not_in.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

createExclusion.description: Whether to create a restrictive exclusion rule. The autonomous agent may create one only on a test-mode rule.

decisionReport.description: Structured audit report explaining the decision, evidence reviewed, trace IDs, missing proof, and recommendations.

decisionSummary.description: Short decision summary to record on the IP/case history.

evidence.description: Evidence strings that support the decision.

expiresInHours.description: Hours until the exclusion stops applying. Omit for a lasting one; the autonomous agent's always expire within 168 hours (the default).

ip.description: IP address to mark as false positive.

ips.description: IP addresses affected by this case-level decision report.

matchMode.description: Condition match mode: all or any.

methods.description: HTTP methods reviewed for this decision.

missingProof.description: Proof that was missing when the row is skipped or ambiguous.

notificationId.description: Notification id from the human action row.

outcome.description: Decision outcome: blocked, rate_limited, false_positive, clean, deferred, case_action, rule_tuning, new_alert_rule, ambiguous, skipped, or other.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

recommendations.description: Follow-up recommendations to record with the decision.

ruleScope.description: Scope: this_rule, specific_rules, all_existing, or any_rule. The autonomous agent uses this_rule only.

statusCodes.description: HTTP status codes reviewed for this decision.

targetRuleIds.description: Specific rule ids when ruleScope is specific_rules.

traceIds.description: Trace IDs reviewed for this decision.

userAgents.description: User agents reviewed for this decision.

verificationId.description: The autonomous agent must pass the verificationId from securenow_agent_verify_ip for this IP (verdict benign or never_block).

name: securenow_human_action_false_positive
title: Mark Human Action False Positive
